proof_summary: For \(n=550172\), the congruence \(2^{k+29400}\equiv2^k\pmod{550172}\) for \(k\ge2\), together with a finite modular avoidance computation over one period, shows that the residue \(63945\) is not attained before \(k=17135927\), so the required least index is at least \(17135927\). A bit-sieve counts more than \(550171\) primes below \(8567965\), implying that the \(550172\)-nd prime is below this number and hence \(2(p-1)\le17135926\), producing the counterexample.
